title: Optimizing Stochastic Policy Geometry for Few-Step Flow Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41949v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-step flow models generate samples through a handful of large denoising transitions. Applying GRPO to such models requires introducing stochasticity into the denoising transitions, and when a single transition spans a wide range of noise levels, the choice of the resulting stochastic policy becomes a major factor in optimization. Recent constructions constrain the policy to preserve the target flow coefficients, but this constraint admits a family of policies and offers no criterion for choosing among them. We introduce Geo-FSRL (Geometry-Optimized Few-Step Reinforcement Learning), built on a selection principle: at a fixed conditioning state and timestep pair, choose the admissible policy that minimizes the conditional KL divergence induced by any given nonzero velocity-output update. translated_title: 面向少步流模型强化学习的随机策略几何优化
translated_abstract: 少步流模型通过少量大幅度的去噪转换来生成样本。将GRPO应用于此类模型需要在去噪转换中引入随机性，而当单次转换跨越较宽的噪声水平范围时，由此产生的随机策略的选择便成为优化中的一个关键因素。近期的构造将策略约束为保持目标流系数，但这一约束会容许一整族可行的策略，且未提供在它们之间进行选择的准则。我们提出了Geo-FSRL（几何优化的少步强化学习），其建立在一个选择原则之上：在给定的条件状态与时间步对下，选择能够使任意给定的非零速度输出更新所引起的条件KL散度最小化的可行策略。在保持系数的各向同性高斯转换族内，该准则可简化为最小化一个单一的标量几何因子（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出Geo-FSRL方法，以最小化任意速度输出更新引起的条件KL散度为原则来选择随机策略，该准则在各向同性高斯转换族中等价于最小化单一标量几何因子，从而为少步流模型强化学习提供了几何优化的策略选择依据。
en_tdlr: Proposes Geo-FSRL, a geometry-optimized selection principle for few-step flow RL that chooses the stochastic policy minimizing the conditional KL divergence induced by any velocity-output update, which reduces to minimizing a single scalar geometry factor within the coefficient-preserving isotropic Gaussian transition family.
